core.description: Practical CTF sandbox profile for triage, scripting, crypto math, pwn payload generation, reverse triage, forensics, web requests, DNS, images, audio, and malware static analysis.

heavy.description: Optional heavier profile for symbolic binary analysis, emulation frameworks, Frida workflows, and local ML model attacks.

sandboxContract.network: The Docker sidecar is configured with network_mode: none. Remote services must be reached through scoped HTTP/TCP tools in the API process.
sandboxContract.filesystem: Challenge input is mounted read-only; every run receives a dedicated scratchRoot/runs/<run-id> namespace with isolated cwd, HOME, and TMPDIR.
sandboxContract.execution: Commands are structured as program + args + optional stdin. Shell parsing is not used. Run namespaces prevent normal tool-protocol access to another run's scratch files; deployment-level containers or microVMs are required for mutually untrusted tenant kernel isolation.
